answer: Sybil resistance rests on a rising capital bond each agent identity must lock in a shared vault before acting, slashed if two accounts share control. A forged identity needs its own collateral, so running k fakes costs roughly k squared in committed capital while payouts stay linear; a nebula of throwaway wallets dies because none can fund the minimum. Any wander of ledger seats is randomized too, so clone operators show overlapping vote patterns and forfeit every linked bond.
